newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 100,000/T gasoline for March.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 100,000/T gasoline for March.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy four 25,000-tonne cargoes of 87-octane leaded gasoline for March delivery, industry sources said on Wednesday.
"It is nothing alarming," said an Indian source, citing the gasoline shortfall to the 30-day scheduled shutdown of an 18,000 barrel-per-day fluid catalytic cracker in Bombay in February.
The tender seeks three cargoes to the west coast--to Bombay and Kandla for March 1-5 and 11-15 delivery, and Goa and Kandla for March 6-10 arrival cost-and-freight (c&f) basis
The fourth cargo is for March 1-5 delivery to Madras and Vizag on the Indian east coast.
The tender closes on February 12 and is valid for two days.
IOC had tendered to buy three cargoes in February to Goa and Kandla.
Its last gasoline purchase, for February 15-29 delivery, was made at $4.50-$5.00 per barrel over Singapore 92-octane unleaded gasoline quotes c&f basis.
IOC had earlier bought its first requirement for the month, February 8-12 arrival, at around a $2.50 premium c&f.
The third tender, for February 21-25 delivery, closes on Wednesday and is valid until January 31.
